comparison: Grid comparison uses periodic cubic interpolation at matching physical cell centers; time-step comparison uses the identical grid.
limits: Finite-time numerical evidence; no error bound or convergence theorem. Centered derivatives have checkerboard null modes. Interpolation is approximate. The grid refinement ratios differ: 128 to 256 is 2; 256 to 384 is 1.5. Smaller differences alone do not establish an observed convergence order. Two time steps measure sensitivity; they do not establish a temporal convergence order.
